meta.name: cloud-sync
meta.description: Set up or check claude-mem cloud sync with cmem.ai Pro. Use when the user says "set up cloud sync", "sync my memories", "cmem pro", "cloud backup", "sync status", or wants their memory database backed up or synced to their cmem.ai account.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将记忆数据备份同步到云端账户
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望将 Claude 记忆安全同步到云端
copy.tagline_en: Back up and sync memory data to your cloud account
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to securely sync your Claude memories to the cloud

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能检查 claude-mem 云同步状态,或将 cmem.ai Connect 页面给出的三项连接信息写入本地配置,重启并验证。过程中不显示同步令牌,只确认其长度。
howto.when: 当用户说“set up cloud sync”“sync my memories”等关键词,或想把记忆数据库备份或同步到 cmem.ai 账号时触发。

say.note: 返回设备 ID、待同步数量以及 Hub 是否可达。

say.text: 把记忆数据库备份到 cmem.ai 账号

howto.what_en: Claude can check claude-mem cloud sync status, or write the three connection values from cmem.ai Connect into local settings, restart, and verify. It never prints the sync token, only confirms its length.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user says “set up cloud sync”, “sync my memories”, etc., or asks to back up or sync the memory database to their cmem.ai account.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync for me.
say_en.note: Checks current status, then asks for the three connection values.

say_en.text: What is the cloud sync status?
say_en.note: Reports device ID, pending counts, and Hub reachability.

say_en.text: Back up my memory database to cmem.ai.
say_en.note: Need the three values from cmem.ai → Connect.
